component: Page level controls in a column of their own beside the application sidebar (Articles, Collections, Quizzes, Courses)
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (education.md E5). Observed: a 240px column held one toggle and one button, next to the application sidebar that already listed Education. Fix: controls that act on a page's list belong in the page title band, results take the full width. Applies P14 (no sidebar stacking: a second navigation like column beside the sidebar) and the meta principle; P14 does not say what to do with a rail of one or two page controls. Candidate lesson, no conflict.

classification.rationale: P14 targets redundant navigation; a column of two page controls is not navigation but has the same cost. Two readings, so ambiguity rather than a clear gap or failure. Owner confirmation needed.
